page.content:
1980s toy line and cartoons that introduced the original pastel ponies.

How My Little Pony (G1) connects

  • Creator: Bonnie Zacherle — Bonnie Zacherle designed the original My Little Pony toys.
  • Series: My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic — The G1 toy era came before Friendship Is Magic remade the brand.
  • Topic: My Little Pony — Generation 1 is the original toy-and-cartoon age of My Little Pony.
  • Concept: Cutie mark — G1 flank symbols became the cutie marks of Friendship Is Magic.

What is My Little Pony (G1)?

Generation 1 My Little Pony is Bonnie Zacherle's toy era: brushable manes, symbols on the flanks, and Saturday-morning specials that Hasbro later treated as the first age of the franchise.

Key threads lead to Bonnie Zacherle, My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic, My Little Pony and Cutie mark.
